title: Lior and the Harvest
author: Ines Vane
blurb: Emrys Quintana, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
